Total exposure is $508.79 across five transactions on 2016-12-03 and 2016-12-04. Recommended actions: BLOCK_CARD (route L1, exposure ≤ $2,500), preceded by STEP_UP_AUTH and CREATE_CASE, with ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST for review.
